input.prompt:
Create an ORIGINAL production-quality environment concept for MAP-A “Zielony Trakt”, a landscape Android 2D tower-defense map. Hand-painted/cartoon organic fantasy, colorful but readable, premium mobile-game quality, true top-down / restrained 3/4 orthographic view. NO text, NO labels, NO logo, NO technical grid, NO UI.

STRICT GAMEPLAY COMPOSITION TO VISUALLY RESPECT:
The logical map is 24 wide x 14 high. A single dirt road starts at the LEFT edge in the upper part, then travels roughly horizontally right across the upper band, bends diagonally down-right into the center, descends, bends down-left back across the middle-lower area, descends again near the left-center, then turns right and runs a long final stretch along the lower band to exit at the RIGHT edge. It should visually correspond to these authored route points, in order: (0,11) → (5,11) → (10,11) → (13,9) → (13,6) → (10,4) → (5,4) → (5,2) → (10,2) → (16,2) → (22,2) → (24,2). Do not print coordinates.

Include exactly 12 natural-looking planting clearings integrated into terrain, not circles or game nodes, near these relative locations: (4,10), (11,9), (12,7), (9,5.5), (7,3), (12.5,3.5), (18,3.5), (21,4), (2.5,12.5), (15,4.4), (2.8,8.5), (22.2,5.1). They should look like small authored garden patches / root-framed clearings and remain visually distinct from the road.

ENVIRONMENT:
lush green meadow and woodland edge, crooked wooden fences, mushrooms, tiny wildflowers, old mossy stones, roots, a few small pond/wet patches placed away from the road, tree stumps, subtle height variation, soft natural shadows. Keep decoration out of combat lanes and planting clearings. The entire tactical map must fit inside one 16:9 phone screen with strong path readability and no required camera scrolling. Clear spawn side at left, clear base/exit side at right. No characters, no enemies, no towers, no futuristic elements. Original IP only.
